Class Scenario

java.lang.Object
domain.Scenario
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Scenario extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a scenario with a specific name, associated restrictions, and map details. This class includes functionality to validate its properties to ensure they meet specified requirements.

  • Constructor Details

    • Scenario

      public Scenario(String name, Restrictions restrictions, Map map, Budget budget)
      Creates a new Scenario instance with the specified name, restrictions, and map. The constructor initializes the scenario's attributes and performs a validation check on the name to ensure it meets required constraints.
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the scenario. Must not be null or empty, must have a maximum length of 15 characters, contain at least one uppercase letter, and consist only of alphanumeric characters.
      restrictions - The restrictions associated with the scenario. Cannot be null.
      map - The map linked to the scenario. Cannot be null.

    • validateName

      public boolean validateName()
      Validates the name of the scenario against specific constraints. The name must not be null or empty, must have a maximum length of 15 characters, must consist only of alphanumeric characters.
      Returns:
      true if the name satisfies all constraints; false otherwise.

    • validateRestrictions

      public boolean validateRestrictions()
      Validates the restrictions associated with the scenario. This method checks if the restrictions object is not null and if it passes its own validation.
      Returns:
      true if the restrictions exist and are valid; false otherwise.

    • equals

      public boolean equals(Object o)
      Compares this scenario with the specified object for equality. Two scenarios are considered equal if they are created for the same map and have the same name, as scenario names should be unique identifiers within the map.
      Overrides:
      equals in class Object
      Parameters:
      o - the object to be compared for equality with this scenario
      Returns:
      true if the specified object is equal to this scenario; false otherwise

    • hashCode

      public int hashCode()
      Returns the hash code value for this scenario. The hash code is computed based on the scenario's name and map to ensure that scenarios with the same name and map have the same hash code, maintaining the general contract of hashCode in relation to equals.
